_comment: Mutation testing for pure helpers with load-bearing invariants. Sentry uses this same pattern across 12 JS SDK packages (https://blog.sentry.io/mutation-testing-js-sdks/). Stryker does NOT instrument Playwright — that's why this targets the unit layer under E2E, not E2E itself. Coverage % only tells you a line ran; mutation score tells you the test would actually catch a regression. Run: npx stryker run
_thresholdsRationale: Start permissive (break=50) so the first run doesn't blow up CI. Ratchet upward as weak assertions get fixed. Meta's research (https://engineering.fb.com/2025/09/30/security/llms-are-the-key-to-mutation-testing-and-better-compliance/) flags that rule-based mutants can be noise — review the HTML report and quarantine non-meaningful mutants via `ignorePatterns` before raising the threshold.
